title: Bouqs Alternatives: 3 Flower Subscriptions Like Bouqs - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Bouqs alternative? Compare three flower subscriptions by price, stems, and schedule, from a monthly Cratejoy box to repeat garden roses.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Buy it on Cratejoy


### BloomsyBox vs The Bouqs Co.


[BloomsyBox](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bloomsybox-com) by BloomsyBox


From $53.99 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bloomsybox-com)


**Best for:** A Bouqs subscriber who likes a surprise bouquet and would rather check out on Cratejoy.


BloomsyBox builds each month’s bouquet around seasonal flowers from sustainable farms, cut for the order. Many stems ship in bud, so you get to watch the arrangement open at home. Past boxes on the listing range from red roses, white snapdragons, and pine cones in December to heliconias and pink ginger in July.


#### What feels familiar


Farm-cut stems that arrive partly closed, free shipping, three bouquet sizes, and a plan you can cancel anytime. The listing also has a gift option.


#### What changes


BloomsyBox picks the flowers, and the box comes once a month. It ships between the 16th and the 23rd, and an order placed after the 9th starts with the next month’s box. Prepaying for 12 months brings the Original down to about $54 a box.


A vase in the first delivery


### UrbanStems vs The Bouqs Co.


**Best for:** Giving flowers someone can set straight on the table, on the same weekday every week, two weeks, or four.


[UrbanStems](https://urbanstems.com/subscriptions) sells three subscription styles. The Seasonal, its most popular, adds a vase to the first bouquet. The Classic skips the vase and sends 15–20 stems for $60, and the Luxe sends 26–30 stems for $105 with a custom vase every time. You can pay as you go, billed seven days before each delivery, or prepay for a set number of deliveries, which is the easier way to give it.


#### What feels familiar


Free shipping, your pick of bouquet before each delivery (or a surprise), and room to skip, reschedule, pause for up to three months, or send one delivery to a new address.


#### What changes


The first bouquet is UrbanStems’ choice, and there’s no every-other-month schedule. The Seasonal costs $16 more than the Bouqs Deluxe, which has a similar stem count. Moving between Classic, Seasonal, and Luxe means canceling and buying a new plan through its care team.


The same bouquet on repeat


### Farmgirl Flowers vs The Bouqs Co.


**Best for:** The reader who found one arrangement they love and wants exactly that, or garden roses, every time.


[Farmgirl Flowers](https://farmgirlflowers.com/shop/subscribable) turns a short list of its arrangements into recurring deliveries, from signature burlap-wrapped bouquets to specialty garden roses. You pick one, choose “Make It A Recurring Delivery”, and set how often it comes and when it starts and stops. The list runs from a dozen garden roses in a surprise color palette at $79 to 24 California-grown Juliet roses at $139.


#### What feels familiar


Weekly, every-two-weeks, or monthly delivery, and you know which flowers are coming. The one exception is the Mystery Box, where the rose color is the surprise.


#### What changes


Every option costs more than the Bouqs Grand. Some arrangements ship free, and others add a shipping fee, charged with the first bouquet and then a few days before each delivery. The menu has eight arrangements, where Bouqs subscribers choose from more than 50.
